prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving forward along a dimly lit path lined with traditional red torii gates at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan. The camera steadily advances through the dense forest, capturing the intricate details of the torii gates as they recede into the foggy night. The surrounding trees loom large, their dark silhouettes barely visible against the cloudy sky, creating an eerie yet serene atmosphere. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle remains level, providing a consistent view of the path ahead. The soft glow from lanterns attached to some of the torii gates casts a warm, reddish hue that contrasts sharply with the cool, misty environment. The ground is covered with fallen leaves and patches of grass, adding texture to the scene. The camera continues its steady movement, passing through the seemingly endless tunnel of torii gates, each one slightly different in size and condition. The fog thickens as the journey continues, partially obscuring distant gates and enhancing the sense of depth and mystery. The overall ambiance is quiet and tranquil, with no other people or sounds disrupting the peaceful solitude of the night-time walk.
